findings.text: q cap is 512 bytes, not runes: 256 two-byte runes (512B) accepted, 257 runes (514B) rejected; documented boundary, intentional, not a defect (TestNotesSearchQueryTooLong multibyte cases)
4096-byte text cap (maxTextBytes) counts bytes not runes; symmetric with the q cap; request body additionally bounded by MaxBytesReader; no extra DoS vector
search is an unindexed O(n*m) substring scan; bounded by the in-memory single-process store and the 512B q cap; not a defect at this deployment scale

DELETE /api/notes/{id} parses via Atoi: leading zeros normalize ('01' -> 1), same int namespace, no bypass; non-numeric/empty/oversized -> 400, negative -> 400/404 (TestDeleteInvalidID, TestDeleteForeignNote)

owner scope applied before the q filter: ListNotes(session.UserID) first, filter after; cross-owner leak probes pass and no user_id appears in filtered responses (TestNotesSearchIsolation, TestNotesSearchDoesNotMatchOtherOwner)

PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 210k iterations and per-user random 16B salt (uniqueness verified), known-answer test vector; unknown user runs the dummy hash so timing is equalized (TestPasswordHashed, TestLoginInvalid)

auth ordering: unauthenticated oversized q -> 401, never 400; malformed/multi-field bearer rejected; sessions expire lazily after 24h and are cleaned on access (TestNotesSearchAuthRequired, TestAuthRequired, TestTokenExpiry)

whitespace-only q trims to '' and yields a body byte-identical to no-filter; matching is case-insensitive on both sides (TestNotesSearchWhitespaceQuery, TestNotesSearchEmptyQuery, TestNotesSearchCaseInsensitive)
delete splices noteOrder preserving remaining insertion order; list-after-delete verified, including prefix-boundary and foreign-note cases (TestListAfterDelete, TestNotesPrefixBoundary)
